title: Chapter 769
text:
At this time, Han Xiao's energy level suddenly increased, and the power of the Mech Legion increased. Heber was caught off guard and was sent flying by a series of particle cannons.

Heber's rising momentum was interrupted, and this made the countless spectators excited.

"Black Star was actually hiding such strength …" Sisko's expression changed slightly.

The energy level Han Xiao released at this time surprised him. He was very sure that Black Star did not have such strength when they fought more than a month ago.

Is this his trump card?

Ames could not help but glance at Han Xiao, and a look of surprise flashed across her eyes.

Seeing that their boss had created a gap in their formation, Joad's expression changed. The excitement of the Bloodshed Land officers was instantly extinguished.

Although Heber only suffered a small loss, the opponent was only a new Beyond Grade A. The Bloodshed Land officers originally thought that the Tyrant would have the upper hand and beat Black Star into a sorry state. However, the situation before their eyes shocked them.

The Mech Legion chased after him, and this time, Heber stabilized his body. His expression was solemn, and he was a little angry that he had suffered a small loss without being prepared.

He punched out with a bang, sending out thick Martial Dao waves. An authentic Star Shaking Fist went up against the mechanical army.

The mechanical soldiers in charge of defense moved from the back to the front, and they released psionic energy, forming a huge psionic shield in front of the army.

The Star Shaking Punch hit the psionic shield, and a dazzling reddish-gold light expanded rapidly like a supernova explosion. Everyone was blinded by the light, and their vision was completely white.

The Mech Legion was stopped by the Star Shaking Punch, and Heber took the opportunity to rush out. He circled around and moved the battlefield back to the Bloodshed Land's formation. Han Xiao followed closely behind, controlling the Mech Legion to entangle with him once again.

The Mech Legion, which was enhanced by Perfect Mechanical Sense, had a huge increase in both offense and defense, and they were locked in battle with Heber. Millions of mechanical soldiers surrounded one person, and the light of psionic energy flashed again and again on the battlefield.

Heber suddenly slowed down, enduring the bombardment, and once again used [Energy Lock] on Han Xiao.

However, this time, Han Xiao had experience and escaped the control of the Void Jump Punch with his Chaos Body, which surprised Heber. He thought that Han Xiao's Void Jump was still on cooldown.

"The same trick is useless against me."

Han Xiao secretly smiled.

Heber frowned, knowing that he had made a mistake. His control skill was broken, and he could only patiently deal with the Mech Legion while thinking of other ways.

Punches, kicks, and shockwaves shot out in all directions. The mechanical soldiers were severely damaged, and some were even killed instantly.

Heber was not completely unscathed either. Wounds gradually appeared on his mountain-like body. There were cuts made by the sharp blades and burn marks from the particle cannons.

He used his energy to increase the activity of his cells, and the old wounds healed continuously, but new wounds also appeared continuously. The mechanical soldiers that were destroyed by him were repaired by Han Xiao time and time again with [Waste Modification] and [Advanced Machinery Construction].

"Perfect Mechanical Sense is truly a godly ability …" Feeling the Mechanical Force flowing in his body, Han Xiaoxin was excited.

The 1.4 times Machinery Affinity bonus was an overpowered Molding Grade ability, and the damage that the Mech Legion dealt to Heber was obviously on another level. The difference in strength between him and the Tyrant was more than made up for by Perfect Mechanical Sense.

Unfortunately, this Molding Ability came from Reynold's Character Summon Card and was not his own ability. He had a total of three chances to use it, and this was the second time.

After fighting for a while, Heber's expression became more and more solemn.

He originally thought that no matter how talented a new Beyond Grade A was, the upper limit of their combat strength would not be too ridiculous. However, Han Xiao's current combat strength had broken this logic. His strength had suddenly skyrocketed, and the pressure that the mechanical army brought to him had also increased.

The situation suddenly became evenly matched. Heber's intention to end the battle quickly was crushed, and he was forced to fight a protracted battle where he had to dismantle machines with his bare hands. It was a battle of attrition.

Attrition battles were the strength of the Army Style Mechanic, and Heber knew that the battle was dragged into Black Star's rhythm. If this continued, the situation would not be good for him.

He wanted to establish his dominance, but if he was evenly matched with Black Star, the situation would be reversed.

At that time, not only would he not be able to achieve his goal of establishing dominance, he would also lose his reputation and be used as a stepping stone. This would instead make Black Star famous. Black Star was a new Beyond Grade A Super and lacked a strong foundation, so it was definitely a positive thing for him to fight to a draw with a famous veteran like him.

It was like trying to steal a chicken only to end up losing the rice used to lure it.

Furthermore, he was the one who initiated the battle. If he could not do anything to Black Star and had to leave with his tail between his legs, it would definitely be extremely embarrassing.

Close combat was the trump card of a Pugilist. Although Heber also had long-range attacks like the Star Shaking Fist, a Beyond Grade A Mechanic had too many ways to block long-range attacks. If he wanted to heavily injure Black Star, the only way was to give Black Star a series of explosive attacks in close combat.

Heber's close combat damage was extremely terrifying. Looking at all the Beyond Grade As in the entire galaxy, not a single one of them could remain unscathed after being hit by a Beyond Grade A Pugilist. Even Heber did not dare take a series of attacks from a Pugilist of the same level.

He did have a move that could allow him to instantly close in, but this move could only be used once after a long interval. Black Star had so many evasion and control skills, so he could easily increase the distance between them again, which made him feel quite troubled.

"Slippery fellow." Heber frowned. The opportunity to close in was fleeting, so he had to wait for the next opportunity …

…

Heber and the Mech Legion fought fiercely. Explosions lit up the vision of the spectators time and time again, and almost all the spectators' spaceship radars kept repeating the warning.

"High energy reaction detected! Please leave immediately! Detected … "

This meant that Han Xiao and Heber were fighting in space. If the battlefield was a planet, the two of them would have destroyed it long ago.

A portion of the particle cannons missed and shot in all directions. The spectators in the front row hurriedly retreated to avoid the aftershocks, leaving more space for the two of them to fight.

"The situation seems to have been evened out?"

"Black Star is actually evenly matched with the Tyrant. I thought he would be at a disadvantage."

"Now, the Tyrant seems to be in a passive position."

Countless spectators were shocked, and their evaluation of Black Star was constantly refreshed.

Seeing that Han Xiao had stabilized himself, the Black Star Corps players became excited.

"Black Star is using kiting tactics to control the situation, and the only way for the Tyrant to break out of this situation is to close in. However, it seems that he is unable to cross the strategic depth of the mechanical army." In the army's battleship, Hao Tian analyzed the situation with a deep voice. As a pro player, although his level was not high, it did not hinder his PK vision.

Mad Blade pondered and said, "Pugilists are good at close combat. As long as the Army Commander keeps using kiting tactics, he will be invincible … provided that the Mech Legion can sustain the consumption."

"That's what I think." Pork Bun nodded.

However, at this time, something unexpected happened in the battle. The expressions of Hao Tian, Mad Blade, and the others changed drastically.

"Not good!"

…

The Mech Legion focused their fire and exploded a dazzling energy cluster, affecting everyone's vision.

At this time, Heber suddenly disappeared from the encirclement of the mechanical army.

The next moment, he appeared behind Han Xiao and instantly closed in.

"He really came." Han Xiao's eyes flashed. He had expected this. He knew that Heber definitely had a Pugilist skill that allowed him to teleport, so he had been prepared. However, he had to admit that Heber's timing was not bad.

Heber has used Race Talent [Giant's Gaze] on you!

You have entered [Forced Silence] state. All skills are frozen. Duration: 0.3 seconds!

Han Xiao's pupils constricted. He could not break the Forced Silence skill. Heber had waited until now to use it, and he was caught off guard.

This silence interrupted his Void Hyperdrive and made him stay where he was.

Heber has used [Force Fist — Molecular Shock] on you!

Authentication in progress … Authentication failed. Your STR is more than 1,000 points lower than the opponent.

This is not good. Han Xiao thought to himself.

He had been avoiding the combo attacks of the Pugilist, but Heber's methods were not easy to deal with. Now, he was in a passive position.

In the next moment, reddish-gold fists rained down on his body. The speed of the fists was so fast that they left behind countless afterimages. Dents were left on the surface of the Mech, and the air inside the Mech leaked out.

Dong dong dong!

His eardrums vibrated, and the dull sounds echoed in his body.

Each of Heber's attacks was a different Pugilist skill. Once he got close and successfully used the first control skill, he would be able to use consecutive control skills. Due to the double advantage of Strength and Dexterity, control skills were usually successful.

The terrifying damage from the combo caused Battle Tiger's mechanical suit and health to drop rapidly.

Cold murderous intent appeared in Heber's eyes. Finally, he found an opportunity. He did not hesitate to use all his strength, preparing to severely injure or even kill Han Xiao directly!

…

The development of the battle made the expressions of countless people change drastically.

"Black Star is in danger …" Austin mumbled.

Being controlled by Heber was enough to threaten the life of a Beyond Grade A Super.

A Beyond Grade A Pugilist had explosive power, and as long as their attributes were superior, they would be able to maintain a combo. If they could not escape from the control, they might even be killed in one combo.

Ames could not help but look over.

"Chance!"

At this moment, Sisko suddenly moved. He charged into the battlefield at high speed and headed straight for Han Xiao.

Ames's attention was distracted, and she was slower by a beat. Seeing this, anger appeared in her eyes.

She was about to raise her hand and release a force field to drag Sisko back when suddenly, the Arcane Church fleet opened fire. Highly concentrated Annihilation Rays shot toward Ames.

Ames did not expect the fleet to suddenly attack. She hurriedly turned around and set up a force field defense in front of her, blocking the fleet's attacks.

With this distraction, Sisko took the opportunity to close in on Han Xiao and Heber.

"Black Star is being controlled by the Tyrant. This is the best time to snatch the Evolution Cube!"

The sudden change in the situation shocked everyone. In everyone's eyes, the Arcane Church had broken the rules and used their fleet to restrain Ames while Sisko attacked together with Heber. The two Beyond Grade As surrounded Black Star!

It was as if Black Star was in a desperate situation!

"Teacher!" "Black Star!" "Army Commander!"
